messages:
Lina (People Ops): quick heads-up 9 were onboarding 6 folks Mon 09:00 (SF hub + 3 remote). Two hires have passport e-verify exceptions and one is located in Berlin 1 needs local notary. Need badge escort, courier for welcome kits, and notary coverage. who can help with last-mile?
Alex K: Ill do badge escort at 08:50, kiosk 2. Please post the final escort list here.
Maria P: Ive compiled the escort list and printed basic welcome slips. Laptops: 2 stuck in staging, tagging error. IT-OPS can you confirm reimage and asset-tagging timeline?
IT-OPS: Reimage started. ETA ~2h; well flag assets as "onboard-ready" and place in onboarding-lab rack. If anyone needs VPN pre-provisioned, tell us now.
BadgeBot: Badge queue: 4 pending. Recommended template: NewHire-Quick. Estimated print start 08:40.
Shaun L: For the passport exceptions and Berlin notary, suggest SignFleet for SF and NotarizeNow vendor for Berlin. Lina, budget ok?
Lina (People Ops): Approved both vendors. Shaun, DM vendor contacts & booking codes. Maria, please schedule a 1:1 benefits drop-in for remote folks who want Day-1 walkthroughs.
Maria P: Scheduled benefits drop-in 13:30 PT (30m). Zoom link sent to the group email. Also added note to checklist: "temporary admin rights (basic-admin) expire 7 days" for the engineer who needs to run installs.
Alex K: One remote hire in CET asked for early access due to timezone. Recommend temporary admin for 3 days and a follow-up offboarding task. Approve?
Lina (People Ops): Approve 3 days for CET remote, 7 days for on-site. Add auto-revoke reminders in the welcome doc.
Shaun L: Courier payload sample for AM slot:
```
{"slot":"AM-10","parcels":["KIT-1001","KIT-1002","NOTARY-ENVELOPE-3"],"instructions":"leave with front desk, label 'onboard'"}
```
IT-OPS: VPN pre-provision done for one asset. Remaining two need user activation. Laptops will be stickered with temp tags ONB-001..ONB-006.
BadgeBot: Badges printed for 4 hires. Two held for e-verify exceptions.
Security: Well hold lobby doors 09:05-09:25. For Berlin notary, Security to confirm satellite office access code.
Lina (People Ops): Shaun, meet SignFleet 09:15 at kiosk. Maria, confirm courier pickup tonight and leave express kit notes. Post here once both are booked and Ill mark the checklist green. :partyparrot:
Alex K: sending QR door update to Security now.
Maria P: Courier confirmed for 07:30 pickup. NotarizeNow booked for Berlin 10:00 CET. All set from my side.
Lina (People Ops): Perfect 1 thanks team. Ill drop the final morning runbook and check-in cadence here at 07:30 tomorrow.
